email.subject: Still dealing with that pain?
email.body:
Hi Sarah,

A while back you reached out about your low back. If it's still bothering you, we'd love to help.

Every session at Pinnacle is one-on-one with your physical therapist, never a tech or an aide, and we look at your whole body to find the root cause, without medications, injections or surgery.

Reply to this email or text us to book a $49 Discovery Visit. You'll leave knowing what's going on, whether PT can help, how long it should take and what it will cost.

The Pinnacle Physical Therapy team

close_intro: Your site already sells a $49 Discovery Visit, so we're not changing your offer, just putting it in front of more of the right people in Little Rock and making sure every one of them gets an answer. Here's what we commit to.
chat_context:
Pinnacle Physical Therapy, Little Rock, Arkansas. Opened in August 2017 by Dr. Brian Murphy and his wife Chelsea Murphy (CFO).

Clinicians: Dr. Brian Murphy, DPT, OCS, ATC, PES, TPI Level 2 Medical. Owner. BS Athletic Training (University of Central Florida), Doctorate of Physical Therapy (University of North Florida), completed a year-long orthopedic residency at Florida Hospital Orlando, Orthopedic Clinical Specialist since 2015 (one of only 26 OCS physical therapists in Arkansas at the time the site was written), Athletic Trainer Certified, Performance Enhancement Specialist, Level 2 Titleist Performance Institute (TPI) Medical Provider, TMJ/TMD specialist. Steve Forbush, PT: more than 46 years as a physical therapist, orthopedic residency, APTA certified orthopedic specialist, Certified Manual Therapist, 17 years as a professor in the PT program at the University of Central Arkansas; focuses on complex pain and movement disorders. Patient care coordinator: Madison Rogers. The site also mentions licensed massage therapists.

The Pinnacle Promise: every session is with your physical therapist, not a technician or aide. One-on-one care, more time with your therapist, faster relief and fewer visits needed. Most of the time you see the same therapist every visit. Easy access to your therapist by phone, text or email. A video-based home exercise program. Clear communication about costs, goals and a timeline for recovery. Holistic, whole-body approach to find the root cause; the goal is relief without medications, injections or surgery. Three pillars: Analyze (movement and lifestyle, head to toe), Educate (understand your plan of care), Empower (show positive changes in session, then a video-based home program).

Conditions treated: head and neck pain, headaches and migraines, pinched nerve or herniated disc in the neck, TMJ disorder (jaw pain, clicking, popping, headaches, pain chewing or yawning; works alongside your dentist), shoulder pain (rotator cuff tear, impingement, bursitis, frozen shoulder/adhesive capsulitis, labral tear, AC joint, arthritis, thoracic outlet syndrome), mid back pain, low back pain (chronic low back pain, herniated disc, degenerative disc disease, sciatica, SI joint pain, scoliosis), hip pain (osteoarthritis, bursitis, impingement, labral tears), knee pain (meniscus tear, patellar tendinitis, patellofemoral pain, IT band syndrome, hamstring injury), foot and ankle pain (plantar fasciitis, ankle sprain, Achilles tendinopathy, calf strain), vertigo, sports injuries, post-surgery rehab.

Services: physical therapy, manual therapy, dry needling, blood flow restriction training, Class 4 laser therapy, pain neuroscience education, TMJ therapy, sports therapy, golf health program (TPI golf body screening, golf pain/injury rehab, golf performance), tennis and pickleball injury prevention, orthotics assessment, wellness services (fitness and exercise programs, injury prevention, fall prevention), massage therapy. Evaluations offered: wellness evaluation, injury evaluation, sports performance evaluation (full-body assessments).

First step: the $49 Discovery Visit, paid when you book. You sit down with a physical therapist, tell your story, and get a brief history and movement screen. You leave knowing: what's going on and the root cause, whether a PT can help your issue, how long it should take to see results, what it will cost, and what you can start doing at home. It's also a chance for the team to make sure you're a good fit. This is what you book.

Pricing: the Discovery Visit is $49. Other prices are not listed; the cost of a plan of care is explained at the Discovery Visit. Insurance: the website does not say whether insurance is accepted; have the team confirm.

Location: 12511 Cantrell Rd, Suite 100, Little Rock, AR 72223. Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 7pm. Phone (501) 529-2010, you can text or call. Rated 4.9 to 5.0 stars on Google.

Real patient reviews: Barry (52, retired police lieutenant) couldn't play golf for 4 years due to thoracic back pain and had seen several of the so-called best pain doctors and physical therapists in Little Rock; Dr. Murphy evaluated his whole body and got him back to playing golf. Jeannie: pain down her leg went away in one session and hadn't returned 6 months later. Ned Perme (retired from Channel 7) got back on the pickleball court after eight weeks of treatment for plantar fasciitis, including nine Class 4 laser treatments.
